vector.hero.title: The world's first AI that
vector.beyond.subtitle: Manufacturing faces a “data-rich, decision-poor” paradox. Vector closes the gap that generic AI cannot.
vector.beyond.problem.body: Factories generate exascale telemetry, yet optimization still waits on slow human analysis. Data is no longer the bottleneck — the missing piece is a decision system.
vector.beyond.generic.body: GPT and other LLMs are “industrially blind”. They are not grounded in factory physics, MTM motion analysis or operational constraints. Their answers read well and mean little on the shop floor.
vector.pipeline.steps.01.title: Context construction
vector.pipeline.steps.01.body: Raw telemetry from ERP, WMS and IoT systems is normalized into a structured operational model with process flows, constraints and baseline metrics.
vector.pipeline.steps.02.title: Baseline quantification
vector.pipeline.steps.02.body: Operational indicators derived from ISO 22400-2 establish a rigorous as-is state — cycle times, FTE allocation, baseline OEE.
vector.pipeline.steps.03.title: Causal structural analysis
vector.pipeline.steps.03.body: The engine identifies hidden root causes of inefficiency and how they depend on each other, through automated planning logic rather than surface pattern matching.
vector.pipeline.steps.04.title: Action plan construction
vector.pipeline.steps.04.body: Interventions are sequenced for maximum feasibility, accounting for resource availability, technical dependencies and operational constraints.
vector.pipeline.steps.05.title: Board-level financial evaluation
vector.pipeline.steps.05.body: Every technical intervention is translated into balance-sheet impact — ROI projections, CAPEX/OPEX trajectories, payback estimates.
vector.pipeline.steps.06.title: Structured decision artifact
vector.pipeline.steps.06.body: The output is not prose — it is a complete, defensible business case with a diagnostic summary, a prioritized action plan and financial projections.
vector.roadmap.stages.1.label: Stage 1
vector.roadmap.stages.1.title: Analytical systems
vector.roadmap.stages.1.body: Telemetry goes digital. Human judgement still dominates.
vector.roadmap.stages.2.label: Stage 2
vector.roadmap.stages.2.title: Decision support
vector.roadmap.stages.2.body: Structured AI-generated recommendations, validated by experts. Vector 1.0 operates here.
vector.roadmap.stages.3.label: Stage 3
vector.roadmap.stages.3.title: Bounded automation
vector.roadmap.stages.3.body: AI autonomously executes predefined low-risk interventions within controlled parameters.
vector.roadmap.stages.4.label: Stage 4
vector.roadmap.stages.4.title: Autonomous decision systems
vector.roadmap.stages.4.body: A fully closed loop with real-time feedback and iterative learning.
